en: Fixed `known_marketplaces.json` recording a marketplace as refreshed when its remote could not be reached and `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_KEEP_MARKETPLACE_ON_FAILURE` kept the existing clone
zh: 修复在无法访问 marketplace 远程源且 `CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_KEEP_MARKETPLACE_ON_FAILURE` 保留现有克隆时，`known_marketplaces.json` 仍将 marketplace 记录为已刷新的问题
